title: The Corruptor's Last Stand
narrative: The Corruptor has hidden himself in the open cases assigned to Field Detectives.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE case_files (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE detectives (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, rank TEXT NOT NULL); CREATE TABLE assignments (case_id INTEGER NOT NULL, detective_id INTEGER NOT NULL);
seed_sql: INSERT INTO case_files VALUES (1, 'The Missing Row', 'Closed'), (2, 'The Infinite Loop', 'Open'); INSERT INTO detectives VALUES (1, 'Ada', 'Chief'), (2, 'Player', 'Field Det'); INSERT INTO assignments VALUES (1, 1), (2, 2);

hints.content: Combine everything you've learned: JOIN, WHERE, and aggregates.
You are on your own for the final boss!

hints.code_snippet: SELECT c.title, d.name FROM case_files c JOIN assignments a ON c.id = a.case_id JOIN detectives d ON a.detective_id = d.id WHERE c.status = 'Open' AND d.rank = 'Field Det';
